name: Band-Assisted Dip
steps: Loop a heavy resistance band across both parallel dip bars, press up onto the bars, and place both knees securely onto the band.
Brace your core, keep your shoulders packed down, and start with your arms fully extended.
Bend your elbows smoothly to lower your body until your upper arms reach roughly parallel to the floor.
Press firmly back up through your palms until your elbows lock straight again.
tips: Keep your shoulders depressed away from your ears at the bottom rather than sinking passively into the joint.
Lower under full control so the band assists smoothly without bouncing you upward.
